annotations.text: Read the cover first: the five findings, the five moves, the four-part rule with what renders when it fails, and the owner's three calls (H-70). Page 2 holds the surfaces, one move each; moves 4 and 5 share a board.

This is the second look at the 2026-09-07 brief. The first, Nothing from nowhere, answered the half about animation and holds H-69. Nothing here repeats it; every move on this canvas is a feature, and the motion any of them takes is that canvas's physics.

Blue Mantis Divers, Thursday August 27, 2026: Keiko Tanaka's own iPhone at the door; Dana Reyes at the counter at 6:43 with Priya Sharma; Grace Mensah's card at 6:46. Every name is invented. Reef in Geist on every staff board; the waiver page in DiveDay's own tokens, as it ships.
The card in the viewfinder is invented and belongs to no agency: no logo, no real card. The phone's passkey sheet and camera sheet are the platform's own, drawn only to show where the glance happens.

Sign here is H-70 b's whole existence: declined, the row keeps its two doors and the session lock is not built. The Read marks on the Card board are H-70 c's: declined, the camera door still moves to the top of the form and the fields stay typed.
